ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the rise of Medicaid fraud cases and the measures being taken to prevent them.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and investigation of Medicaid claims and providers
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
How can Medicaid fraud be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale problem and highlight the need for increased scrutiny of Medicaid claims and providers. I will use data analysis and investigation to uncover the scope of the issue and identify potential solutions.
